heading.en: Pay the call — or lose the shares
heading.kn: ಕರೆ ಹಣ ಕೊಡಿ — ಇಲ್ಲವೇ ಷೇರು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

hook.en: A shareholder paid application money but ignored the allotment and call notices. The company can take back his shares and keep what he paid.
hook.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಷೇರುದಾರ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕರೆ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿದ. ಕಂಪನಿ ಅವನ ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆದು ಅವನು ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಹಣ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು.

objectives.en: Record forfeiture of shares issued at par and at premium
Transfer the gain to Capital Reserve

narration.en: A shareholder paid application money but ignored the allotment and call notices. The company can take back his shares and keep what he paid. That is forfeiture, and the company may later reissue those shares.
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಷೇರುದಾರ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕರೆ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿದ. ಕಂಪನಿ ಅವನ ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆದು ಅವನು ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಹಣ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಇದೇ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು; ಕಂಪನಿ ನಂತರ ಆ ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಮರುವಿತರಿಸಬಹುದು.

body.en: Share Capital A/c is debited with the amount called up on the forfeited shares; the unpaid calls are credited to the respective call accounts (or Calls in Arrears); the amount already received is credited to Share Forfeiture A/c. If the shares were issued at a premium and the premium has not been received, Securities Premium A/c is also debited; if the premium was received, it is not cancelled.
body.kn: ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆದ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖರ್ಚು, ಬಾಕಿ ಕರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ, ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಷೇರು ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೂ ಖರ್ಚು.

narration.en: Share Capital A/c is debited with the amount called up on the forfeited shares; the unpaid calls are credited to the respective call accounts (or Calls in Arrears); the amount already received is credited to Share Forfeiture A/c. If the shares were issued at a premium and the premium has not been received, Securities Premium A/c is also debited; if the premium was received, it is not cancelled.
narration.kn: ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆದ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖರ್ಚು, ಬಾಕಿ ಕರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ, ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಷೇರು ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೂ ಖರ್ಚು.

body.en: Forfeited shares may be reissued, even below face value: Bank A/c Dr, Share Forfeiture A/c Dr (discount), To Share Capital A/c. The discount cannot exceed the amount forfeited on those shares. The balance left in Share Forfeiture A/c on the reissued shares is a capital profit and is transferred to Capital Reserve.
body.kn: ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಖಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಗೆ ಮರುವಿತರಿಸಬಹುದು; ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮೀರಬಾರದು. ಉಳಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಲಾಭ — ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮೀಸಲಿಗೆ ವರ್ಗ.

problem.en: Ravi holds 100 shares of ₹10 each (₹3 application, ₹4 allotment, ₹3 call). He paid only the application money and his shares were forfeited after the call. They were reissued at ₹8 per share fully paid. Pass the entries and find the capital reserve.

steps.en: Forfeiture: Share Capital A/c Dr 1,000; To Share Allotment A/c 400; To Share First and Final Call A/c 300; To Share Forfeiture A/c 300.
Reissue: Bank A/c Dr 800; Share Forfeiture A/c Dr 200; To Share Capital A/c 1,000.
Balance in forfeiture on these shares = 300 − 200 = ₹100.
Share Forfeiture A/c Dr 100; To Capital Reserve A/c 100.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Ravi holds 100 shares of ₹10 each (₹3 application, ₹4 allotment, ₹3 call). He paid only the application money and his shares were forfeited after the call. They were reissued at ₹8 per share fully paid. Pass the entries and find the capital reserve.

heading.en: Forfeit what was paid, cancel what was called

body.en: Debit share capital with the called-up amount; credit forfeiture with only what the shareholder actually paid towards capital.

narration.en: Forfeit what was paid, cancel what was called. Debit share capital with the called-up amount; credit forfeiture with only what the shareholder actually paid towards capital.

points.en: The amount received is credited to Share Forfeiture Account.
points.kn: ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಷೇರು ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ.

points.en: Discount on reissue cannot exceed the amount forfeited.
The remaining gain goes to Capital Reserve.

homework.en: Pass entries if Ravi's 100 shares were reissued at ₹7 per share fully paid.

narration.en: Recap. On forfeiture, share capital is debited with the called-up amount. The amount received is credited to Share Forfeiture Account. Discount on reissue cannot exceed the amount forfeited. The remaining gain goes to Capital Reserve.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆದ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖರ್ಚು. ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಷೇರು ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಮರುವಿತರಣೆಯ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಮೊತ್ತ ಮೀರಬಾರದು. ಉಳಿದ ಲಾಭ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮೀಸಲಿಗೆ.
